When the pronoun युष्मद् 'thou' understood, and also when the same expressed, is the attendant word in the agreement with the verb, then there is the verbal termination called the middle (2nd person).

Terms:

The affix खञ् also comes optionally in the remaining senses after the words 1. युष्मद् and 2. अस्मद्।

Terms: खञ्

The acute accent is on the first syllable of युष्मद् and अस्मद् in the Genitive Singular.

Terms: accent-छन्दस

, is substituted for the Genitive 6th-Case ending अस् after the अङ्ग (stems) युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

Terms: Some substitution

आ is substituted for the final of युष्मद् and अस्मद् before a case-ending.

Terms: सर्वनाम युष्मद्- अस्मद्

dual of युष्मद् and अस्मद् are substituted वाम and नौ respectively ।

Terms: सर्वनाम

The स् standing in the inner half of a stanza is changed to ष् before the त of त्वम् etc. and युष्मद्।

Terms: षत्व change
